Application Data.NAME: Creative Sound Solutions, Inc.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Sound Solutions, Inc. specializes in the sales and rental of audio and visual equipment, offering comprehensive services that include installation, repair, and technical support. Our operations encompass a wide range of products, from professional sound systems to high-definition video displays, catering to both corporate clients and individual consumers. We prioritize quality service, ensuring that all equipment is thoroughly tested and maintained to meet the highest standards. Additionally, we are committed to mitigating risks associated with our operations, including product liability and proper handling of equipment during installation and service.

Summary:
Audio and visual equipment sales and service businesses present a diverse risk profile
that combines product liability, property exposure, and service-related hazards. Underwriters must
carefully assess the insured’s operations, including sales, rental, installation, and repair activities,
to tailor coverage appropriately. Attention to rental equipment coverage, installation risks, and
product liability is essential, as is awareness of emerging exposures such as drone use in A/V ser-
vices. Properly structured policies and endorsements help mitigate losses and support the insured’s
business continuity.
